name: Albertine Parsouffe
source:
“Do you play? I am versed in the viola, piano and flute - though I do not like to boast.”
An excellent musician and hostess, Albertine is well aware of her accomplishments, though this self-assuredness could be her downfall.

[From [url=https://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?t=40623]Lemma Soft Forums[/url]]
